what: Short film for sharing (2 min): clearance, sound levels and the exported video
viewer: http://127.0.0.1:8765/OPEN_CHURCH.html (scratch origin, recommended design, 354 items of which 15 hidden)

clearance.method: CHURCH_CINEMA.audit({ film: 'short', step: 0.2, reach: 1.5 }); wiring-only scenes are checked against the building as if it were shown

figuresShown.source: read from the open model when the film starts (CHURCH_SIMULATOR.powerSummary(), electrical.routes, visible items by catalogue category)
figuresShown.limits: Simulator values of a design-development model. Route length is the modelled route, not installed cable length. Connected rating is the sum of ratings, not operating consumption (5.6 kW in the scene that was open).

musicOutput.what: Digital level of the generated bells and organ after the limiter, largest value in each scene during one real-time run. dBFS, not an acoustic level. Measured before the bells were raised by about 3.7 dB; the organ is unchanged.

recordingInViewer.what: Save as video, real time, in the Claude desktop browser pane (Chrome 152) on an Apple-silicon Mac
recordingInViewer.result: MP4, H.264 + AAC, 1920 × 1080, 121.0 s, 47 MB; 956 pictures in 120 s (about 8 a second, 4 to 15 by scene)
recordingInViewer.judgement: Works; too jerky to post from this computer

sharedFile.method: scripts/film_export: 3600 pictures drawn one at a time (406 s), sound from one real-time recording with a 0.06 s lead removed, joined by ffmpeg

ffprobe.video: h264 high, 1920 × 1080, yuv420p limited range BT.709, 30 frames/s, 3600 frames, 9.5 Mbit/s

sharedFile.soundCheck: ffmpeg volumedetect on the first build: mean −20.0 dB, maximum −3.0 dB
sharedFile.viewed: One picture from each of the 12 scenes
